sentences.en: Today, we're going to talk about the idea of platonic soulmates.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们要聊聊柏拉图式灵魂伴侣这个概念。

sentences.en: Now, this topic, this idea was inspired by a conversation that I had with a friend recently.
sentences.zh: 这个话题和想法灵感来源于我最近和一位朋友的对话。

sentences.en: We were talking about relationships, but I think I'm at this stage where the primary relationships in my life are my friendships.
sentences.zh: 我们当时在谈论人际关系，但我觉得自己正处于这样的人生阶段：我生命中最主要的关系其实是我的友谊。

sentences.en: And especially in the last two years, I have felt a love and these feelings and emotions for them that are deeper than some of the romantic experiences
sentences.zh: 尤其是在过去的两年里，我对她们产生了一种爱以及种种情感，这种情感甚至比我经历过的一些浪漫体验

sentences.en: and romantic connections that I felt.
sentences.zh: 和浪漫连接还要深厚。

sentences.en: I've had friends, and I realized this recently, who I have loved more than any boyfriend, than any partner.
sentences.zh: 我有一些朋友——我最近才意识到这一点——我爱她们胜过任何男朋友、胜过任何伴侣。

sentences.en: Their love has sustained me for longer periods of time.
sentences.zh: 她们给予我的爱支撑了我更长的时间。

sentences.en: It has been unconditional.
sentences.zh: 那是无条件的。

sentences.en: I can look at them and know that they will never judge me, that they make my life better, that I grow and I learn from them.
sentences.zh: 看着她们，我深知她们永远不会评判我，她们让我的生活变得更好，我从她们身上不断成长、汲取知识。

sentences.en: And it's this feeling that doesn't really seem to fit in the friendship box for me.
sentences.zh: 而这种感觉对我来说似乎并不能简单地塞进“友谊”这个框框里。

sentences.en: It's something a lot more profound.
sentences.zh: 这是一种深邃得多的东西。

sentences.en: And a key characteristic of those kinds of relationships are that distance doesn't really matter.
sentences.zh: 这类关系的一个关键特征在于，距离其实并不重要。

sentences.en: Proximity doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 地域的远近并不重要。

sentences.en: Even similarity doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 甚至相似性也不重要。

sentences.en: It seems that there is this almost soulful, deep, inexplicable sensation and bond that ties us together.
sentences.zh: 似乎存在着一种几乎是灵性的、深沉的、无法言喻的感觉和纽带将我们紧紧联系在一起。

sentences.en: I think we often think about the idea of soulmates and the concept of soulmates in a very restricted manner.
sentences.zh: 我想我们通常对灵魂伴侣的想法和概念抱有一种非常狭隘的看法。

sentences.en: We often think about it in terms of romance.
sentences.zh: 我们往往从浪漫的角度去思考它。

sentences.en: We think about it in terms of sex.
sentences.zh: 我们往往从性的角度去思考它。

sentences.en: And sometimes and often there is this debate around whether platonic soulmates can even exiSt.
sentences.zh: 有时甚至经常会有一种争论，那就是柏拉图式的灵魂伴侣是否真的存在。

sentences.en: And part of that discussion is whether men and women can really truly be friends and whether friendship between opposite genders isn't going to be taken up by some sexual tension.
sentences.zh: 而这一讨论的一部分就在于，男女之间是否真的能够存在真正的友谊，以及异性之间的友谊是否总会被某种性张力所侵占。

sentences.en: And I think that the existence of platonic soulmates is the greatest evidence that that can be the case, that that can be the truth.
sentences.zh: 我认为，柏拉图式灵魂伴侣的存在就是最好的证明，证明这种情况是可能的，证明这是真实的。

sentences.en: Because these kinds of relationships, they kind of blur the lines between friendship and romance.
sentences.zh: 因为这类关系模糊了友谊与浪漫的界限。

sentences.en: And I think that's why they're so valuable to talk about today.
sentences.zh: 我想这也是为什么今天探讨这个话题如此具有价值。

sentences.en: Sex is not everything.
sentences.zh: 性并非生活的全部。

sentences.en: I think we know that.
sentences.zh: 我想我们都懂这一点。

sentences.en: And it's particularly evident when we explore this concept.
sentences.zh: 当我们探讨这个概念时，这一点尤为明显。

sentences.en: So today we're going to explore the psychology behind platonic soulmates.
sentences.zh: 所以今天我们将探讨柏拉图式灵魂伴侣背后的心理学。

sentences.en: The distinction between these relationships and friendships compared to our partners, whether they are real, what the science and the psychology has to say about the feelings
sentences.zh: 这些关系与普通友谊以及伴侣关系的区别，它们是否真实存在，科学和心理学对这种感觉有何见解，

sentences.en: they give us, and the foundation of these deep, almost out-of-body relationships.
sentences.zh: 以及这些深厚得几乎超脱肉体的关系的基础是什么。

sentences.en: But further to that, how we know if someone is a platonic soulmate.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，我们还要探讨如何判断某人是否是你的柏拉图式灵魂伴侣。

sentences.en: If someone who has entered our lives matches this profile and this description.
sentences.zh: 如何判断一个走进我们生活的人是否符合这一特征和描述。

sentences.en: This episode, it is dedicated to my platonic soulmates, the loves of my life.
sentences.zh: 这一期节目，献给我的柏拉图式灵魂伴侣们，我生命中的挚爱。

sentences.en: Without further ado, let's get into it.
sentences.zh: 废话不多说，我们切入正题。

sentences.en: A platonic soulmate is a feeling of deep connection and understanding without the romance that we typically associate with the term soulmate.
sentences.zh: 柏拉图式的灵魂伴侣是一种深度的连接感和理解，但没有我们通常与“灵魂伴侣”一词联系在一起的浪漫色彩。

sentences.en: Without the physical connection, without the sexual chemistry.
sentences.zh: 没有身体上的接触，没有性吸引力的化学反应。

sentences.en: Consequently, I think that platonic soulmates offer each other almost a deep soul connection
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为柏拉图式灵魂伴侣为彼此提供了一种几乎是深层的灵魂连接，

sentences.en: that goes beyond feelings of friendship and hits at something deeper that we can't always explain.
sentences.zh: 这种连接超越了友情的感觉，触及了一些我们无法总是解释的深层东西。

sentences.en: The term platonic soulmate was named after the famous ancient philosopher Plato, who came up or was the first one to express this idea of a relationship and a deep love
sentences.zh: “柏拉图式灵魂伴侣”这个术语以著名的古代哲学家柏拉图命名，他提出了或最早表达了这种关系和深沉爱意的理念，

sentences.en: that cannot be pigeonholed into a romantic kind of box.
sentences.zh: 这种爱无法被归类进浪漫的框框里。

sentences.en: And it breaks away from typical conventions of what we think love should look like.
sentences.zh: 它打破了我们认为爱应该呈现的样子的传统常规。

sentences.en: According to this clinical psychologist, her name is Meredith Fullers.
sentences.zh: 根据这位临床心理学家的说法，她的名字叫梅雷迪思·富勒斯。

sentences.en: Platonic soulmates are a very long-term, solid, trusting, and highly satisfying relationship.
sentences.zh: 柏拉图式灵魂伴侣是一种非常长久、稳固、充满信任且高度满意的关系。

sentences.en: And this is backed up by this idea of the triangular theory of love that we have spoken about before on the show.
sentences.zh: 这得到了我们之前在节目中讨论过的爱情三元论的支持。

sentences.en: So according to the triangular theory of love, there are three things that people want in a relationship.
sentences.zh: 因此，根据爱情三元论，人们在关系中有三点追求。

sentences.en: One is passion, and that comes to include things like sex and lust and chemistry and physical connection.
sentences.zh: 一是激情，这包括性、欲望、化学反应和身体连接等内容。

sentences.en: The second is intimacy, and that doesn't just need to mean physical intimacy.
sentences.zh: 第二是亲密感，这不一定仅仅指身体上的亲密。

sentences.en: It also means emotional intimacy, spiritual intimacy, mental intimacy, and finally, commitment.
sentences.zh: 它还意味着情感亲密、精神亲密、心理亲密，最后是承诺。

sentences.en: Those three elements are what makes up any healthy relationship when we think about romance.
sentences.zh: 当我们考虑浪漫关系时，这三个要素构成了任何健康的关系。

sentences.en: But we can adapt that triangular theory of love to represent our soulmates and our platonic soulmates in a better life.
sentences.zh: 但我们可以调整爱情三元论，以更好地代表我们的灵魂伴侣和柏拉图式灵魂伴侣。

sentences.en: So it is just those second two characteristics, firstly, intimacy, and secondly, commitment that a platonic soulmate offers us.
sentences.zh: 因此，柏拉图式灵魂伴侣带给我们的，恰好是后面这两种特质：首先是亲密感，其次是承诺。

sentences.en: And it can also sometimes include passion, not so much sex and lust, hence the term platonic,
sentences.zh: 有时它也可能包含激情，不过不是太多的性与欲望，因此才叫柏拉图式，

sentences.en: meaning devoid of sex and devoid of that kind of physical engagement, but passion in another
sentences.zh: 意指没有性，也没有那种身体上的参与，但它是另一种意义上的激情，

sentences.en: sense, passion for what they're passionate about, passion for their life, passion for their journey.
sentences.zh: 对他们热爱的事物充满激情，对生活充满激情，对他们的人生旅程充满激情。

sentences.en: I think it's important to stress, and I know I just said it, but they do not contain this
sentences.zh: 我认为强调这一点很重要，我知道我刚才已经说过了，但它们不包含这种欲望或性唤起的成分，

sentences.en: kind of element of lust or sexual arousal, which I think honestly makes our platonic soulmates
sentences.zh: 老实说，我认为这使得我们的柏拉图式灵魂伴侣和柏拉图式友谊更具可持续性，尽管这可能会引起争议。

sentences.en: and our platonic friendships a lot more sustainable, although that may be controversial.
sentences.zh: 我认为，当我们把性和身体亲密感夹杂进来时，情况确实会变得复杂得多，这就是为什么我们把柏拉图式灵魂伴侣放在了一定的神坛上。

sentences.en: I think when we add sex and we add physical intimacy into the mix, it does become a lot more complicated, which is why we kind of put platonic soulmates on a bit of a pedestal.
sentences.zh: 对我们来说，它们感觉更纯粹。

sentences.en: They feel more pure to us.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我认为这些关系没有得到它们应有的认可，在更广泛的社会中也没有得到足够的重视。

sentences.en: And I honestly think that these relationships don't get the credit that they deserve, and they're not recognized enough in broader society.
sentences.zh: 我们往往认为生命中有一个人会把我们的生活变成童话。

sentences.en: We tend to think that there is one person out there for us who is going to make our life a fairy tale.
sentences.zh: 正如他们所说，他们会拼好这块拼图，那个人就是我们结婚或约会的人，而我们的友谊相比之下似乎是次要的。

sentences.en: They're going to complete the puzzle, as they say, and that person is the person that we marry or the people that we date, whereas our friendships are kind of secondary to that.
sentences.zh: 我认为引入柏拉图式灵魂伴侣这个概念有点颠覆了这种叙事，

sentences.en: And I think the idea and the introduction of this concept of platonic soulmates kind of flips
sentences.zh: 但这可能会引发争议，也许是因为混淆和使用了“灵魂伴侣”这个词，

sentences.en: that narrative, but it can be controversial, I think perhaps because of the conflation and
sentences.zh: 人们似乎对“灵魂伴侣”或“双生火焰”这个词有着极强的保护欲。

sentences.en: use of the term soulmate, which people appear to be really protective over the term soulmates or twin flames.
sentences.zh: 也许在这里停下来，稍微思考一下这一点很重要。

sentences.en: Maybe it's important to stop and kind of rest on that point for a second here.
sentences.zh: 我确实做过一整集关于这个主题的节目，但本质上，这就是这样一种理念：你与某人有一种超越一切理性的连接。

sentences.en: I did do a full episode on it, but essentially it's this idea that you have a connection with someone that extends beyond all reason.
sentences.zh: 它几乎是超现实的。

sentences.en: It's almost extraterrestrial.
sentences.zh: 它是脱离肉体的。

sentences.en: It's out of body.
sentences.zh: 它与命运、宇宙和上帝等事物有关，所有这些我们无法总是用具体名称来定义的东西。

sentences.en: It is to do with things like fate and the universe and God, all of these things that we can't always put a tangible name to.
sentences.zh: 这就是两个灵魂以某种超自然方式交融的理念。

sentences.en: And it's this idea that two souls abound in some supernatural way.
sentences.zh: 就像我之前说的，人们通常认为伴侣才能为你提供这种体验。

sentences.en: And like I said before, it's often viewed that a partner is what offers you that.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会有一种期望，即与我们的灵魂伴侣结婚并与他们共度一生。

sentences.en: There can be this expectation that we marry our soulmates and we make a life with them.
sentences.zh: 我们组建家庭，这也是为什么它成为约会中的一个热门词汇。

sentences.en: We have a family, hence why it's become a massive term in dating.
sentences.zh: 我经常看到这种情况。

sentences.en: I see this all the time.
sentences.zh: 我收到了很多关于这方面的私信。

sentences.en: I get so many DMs about this.
sentences.zh: 我在我的TikTok算法上、在Instagram上看到人们想要遇到他们的灵魂伴侣，或者声称他们结婚的人就是他们的灵魂伴侣。

sentences.en: I see it on my TikTok algorithm, on my Instagram about people who want to meet their soulmate or who claim that the person they're marrying is their soulmate.
sentences.zh: 这种想法无处不在，但它并不总是应用到我们的友谊中。

sentences.en: This idea is everywhere, but it's not always applied to our friendships.
sentences.zh: 我们有一种信念，存在着一种广泛的说法，即我们只有一个灵魂伴侣。

sentences.en: We have this belief, there is this massive narrative that we only have one.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这是真的。

sentences.en: And I don't believe that is true.
sentences.zh: 我认为柏拉图式灵魂伴侣确实存在。

sentences.en: I think that platonic soulmates do exiSt.
sentences.zh: 他们不仅仅是好朋友。

sentences.en: They're not just good friends.
sentences.zh: 他们不必把性与深厚的情感承诺混为一谈。

sentences.en: They don't have to conflate sex with deep emotional commitment.
sentences.zh: 这就是有一个或多个个体，他们能够给予你的自我和灵魂通常只留给浪漫伴侣的东西。

sentences.en: It's that there is an individual or multiple individuals out there who can provide your self and your soul with what we normally and typically reserve for only a romantic partner.
sentences.zh: 正是这个人走进了你的生活，似乎有着某种点石成金的魔力，让你的每件事都变得更好。

sentences.en: It's this individual who comes into your life and seems to have almost this golden touch where they make everything better for you.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着你需要对他们产生性吸引力。

sentences.en: And it doesn't mean that you need to be sexually attracted to them.
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是我不断重申的观点。

sentences.en: I think that that is the point I keep coming back to.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，我认为性是次要的。

sentences.en: But in this situation, I think sex is secondary.
sentences.zh: 它表明，深厚的情感承诺和性并不需要共存，某人也能成为你的灵魂伴侣。

sentences.en: And what it shows is that deep emotional commitment and sex don't need to coexist for someone to be your soulmate.
sentences.zh: 当我用其他例子来思考这一点时，我想到了那些从19或20岁起就在一起直到70多岁的人。

sentences.en: When I think about this in terms of other examples, I think about people in their 70s who have been together since they were 19 or 20.
sentences.zh: 他们可能不再有身体上的亲密关系，但我们中的许多人看着他们，仍然会称他们为灵魂伴侣，因为存在着那种情感承诺。

sentences.en: And they might not be being intimate physically anymore, but a lot of us would look at them and still call them soulmates because there is that emotional commitment.
sentences.zh: 或者我想到了无性恋。

sentences.en: Or I think about asexuality.
sentences.zh: 一个人对另一个人没有性吸引力，并不意味着当他们在一起时，他们就不能感受到深厚的情感承诺和满足感。

sentences.en: Just because someone isn't sexually attracted to someone doesn't mean that they can't feel a deep emotional commitment and satisfaction when they're around them.
sentences.zh: 我认为这才是最重要的。

sentences.en: And I think that's what matters the moSt.
sentences.zh: 这就是两个人之间分享的情感亲密感。

sentences.en: It's the emotional intimacy that is shared between two people.
sentences.zh: 我认为，情感亲密感在每一种关系中都很重要。

sentences.en: Emotional intimacy, I think, matters in every relationship.
sentences.zh: 但当我们思考柏拉图式灵魂伴侣的概念时，与某人建立那种非常自然的情感亲密感的压力会稍微增加一些。

sentences.en: But when we think about the idea of platonic soulmates, the pressure is a little bit heightened to have that very organic emotional intimacy with someone.
sentences.zh: 本质上，这个术语、这个理念指的是与另一个人分享思想和感受，这种方式是充满信任的、安全的、

sentences.en: And essentially, this term, this idea, it refers to the sharing of thoughts and feelings with another person in a way that is trusting, in a way that is safe,
sentences.zh: 且具有脆弱性的。

sentences.en: and in a way that is vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 这就是彼此在情感上保持开放和诚实。

sentences.en: It's about being emotionally open and honest with each other.
sentences.zh: 情感亲密感有三个组成部分，它们不仅对柏拉图式灵魂伴侣至关重要，对于我们想要培养和维持的所有关系也同样重要。

sentences.en: And there are three components to emotional intimacy that don't just matter for platonic soulmates, but for all relationships that we want to cultivate and sustain.
sentences.zh: 这三点就是：信任、脆弱性和沟通。

sentences.en: These are trust, vulnerability, and communication.
sentences.zh: 如果这三点无法维持，你就不可能与生活中的任何人建立情感亲密感。

sentences.en: You can't have emotional intimacy with anyone in your life if those three things are not sustained.
sentences.zh: 第一点是信任。

sentences.en: The first one being truSt.
sentences.zh: 是的，当我们从关系的层面来考虑这一点时，

sentences.en: Yes, when we think about that in terms of relationships,
sentences.zh: 通常我们会想到忠诚与背叛，能够相信你的伴侣是忠诚的，能够相信你的伴侣永远站在你这边。

sentences.en: normally we think about fidelity and infidelity and being able to trust that your partner is loyal and being able to trust that your partner is in your corner.
sentences.zh: 但当我们更深入地探讨时，我认为信任也仅仅指这样一种理念和感觉：这个人将永远站在你这一边，

sentences.en: But when we examine that a little bit deeper, I think trust also just refers to the idea and the sensation that this person will always be in your corner,
sentences.zh: 他们永远不会对你残酷。

sentences.en: that they will never be cruel.
sentences.zh: 他们永远不会冷酷无情。

sentences.en: They'll never be callous.
sentences.zh: 他们不会试图给你造成伤害。

sentences.en: They aren't going to try and cause you harm.
sentences.zh: 尽管这看起来可能是一个很低的门槛，或者根本不算什么门槛，但相信别人不会试图破坏你，这其实是一个相当低的标准。

sentences.en: And although that might seem like kind of a low barrier or not really a barrier at all, it's quite a low standard that you trust someone isn't going to try and sabotage you.
sentences.zh: 虽然这看起来好像是个很低的门槛，或者根本算不上什么门槛，但信任某人不会试图破坏你，其实是一个相当低的标准。

sentences.en: If that isn't in place, if you can't trust that that person really cares about you and cares about your future and your goals and your welfare,
sentences.zh: 如果这一点没有落实，如果你无法相信这个人是真的关心你、关心你的未来、关心你的目标和你的福祉，

sentences.en: how in the world are you meant to move on to that next stage of emotional intimacy, which is vulnerability?
sentences.zh: 你怎么可能进入情感亲密的下一个阶段，也就是脆弱感呢？

sentences.en: I love the idea of vulnerability.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢脆弱感这个概念。

sentences.en: I adore it.
sentences.zh: 我简直爱极了。

sentences.en: And as someone who listens to a lot of Brene Brown, who talks about vulnerability quite a bit,
sentences.zh: 作为一个经常听布琳·布朗播客的人——她经常谈论脆弱感——

sentences.en: I think it is such an undervalued characteristic and trait and experience to be shared with other people.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一种被严重低估的性格、特质，也是一种与他人分享的体验。

sentences.en: Being vulnerable doesn't just mean trauma dumping on whoever walks in the door.
sentences.zh: 展现脆弱并不意味着向任何进门的人倾倒创伤垃圾。

sentences.en: It's about wanting to share your truth and having it seen and having it heard and knowing that the other person isn't going to judge you and that they will reciprocate your vulnerability with their own.
sentences.zh: 它是关于想要分享你的真实想法，并被看到、被听到，知道对方不会对你评判，并且他们会用自己的脆弱来回应你的脆弱。

sentences.en: That is what I think is at the heart of any beautiful long-term relationship, whether that be a romantic soulmate or a platonic soulmate,
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是任何美好的长期关系的核心所在，无论是浪漫的灵魂伴侣还是柏拉图式的灵魂伴侣，

sentences.en: is this idea that you can be your worst self, your best self with that person.
sentences.zh: 那就是你可以与那个人展现你最糟糕的一面，也可以展现你最好的一面。

sentences.en: You can be so vulnerable, you can break down in front of them, you can be selfish in front of them, you can say things you've never said to anyone else, and they'll still love you.
sentences.zh: 你可以毫无保留地展现脆弱，你可以在他们面前崩溃，你可以在他们面前自私，你可以说出从未对任何人说过的话，而他们依然会爱你。

sentences.en: It's that unconditional compassion and unconditional love and affection that they will always have, and that's really hard to come by.
sentences.zh: 那是他们永远都会给予的无条件的同情、无条件的爱与关怀，而这真的是可遇不可求。

sentences.en: I think the only way that some people ever feel that is with their family members, and even then, sometimes that's not the case.
sentences.zh: 我认为有些人唯一能感受到这一点的地方是他们的家庭成员，即便如此，有时情况也并非如此。

sentences.en: Vulnerability is the second ingredient of emotional intimacy that I think is important to remember and to cultivate.
sentences.zh: 脆弱感是我认为值得铭记和培养的情感亲密的第二个要素。

sentences.en: And the final one is communication.
sentences.zh: 最后一个则是沟通。

sentences.en: You can't know someone, you can't love someone, you can't see someone if the relationship is only marked by silence,
sentences.zh: 如果关系中只有沉默，你就无法了解一个人，无法爱一个人，无法真正看清一个人，

sentences.en: if you don't openly communicate about what is actually going on in your brain.
sentences.zh: 如果你不公开交流你脑海中真正发生的事情。

sentences.en: And I think communication is this way of peering into our subconscious and our unconscious minds and allowing someone to see the things that we want them to see.
sentences.zh: 我认为沟通是窥探我们潜意识和无意识的一种方式，能让别人看到我们希望他们看到的东西。

sentences.en: There is this idea,
sentences.zh: 有这样一种观点，

sentences.en: and I think the thing that gets in the way of a lot of our romantic relationships and even our friendships sometimes is thinking that people should be able to read your mind.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，阻碍我们许多浪漫关系甚至是友谊的因素有时在于，认为别人应该能够读懂你的心思。

sentences.en: And thinking that if they know you well enough, you shouldn't have to communicate with them how you're feeling and what's going on with you.
sentences.zh: 并且认为如果他们足够了解你，你就不需要与他们沟通你的感受以及你身上发生了什么。

sentences.en: But all good relationships have a level of communication that allows them to be sustained.
sentences.zh: 但所有良好的关系都有一个能够维持它们的沟通水平。

sentences.en: And regardless of whether you are connected with someone through this magical, soulful, inexplicable bond,
sentences.zh: 不管你是否通过这种神奇的、深情的、无法解释的纽带与某人相连，

sentences.en: you still need to be able to communicate with them and show them that you care and let them into your mind.
sentences.zh: 你仍然需要能够与他们沟通，向他们展示你在乎他们，并让他们走入你的内心。

sentences.en: So those are the three kind of pillars of emotional intimacy that I think allow us and provide us with the opportunity to have an idea like soulmates.
sentences.zh: 所以这些可以说是情感亲密的三大支柱，我认为它们使我们能够并为我们提供了产生灵魂伴侣这种概念的机会。

sentences.en: They are, again, trust, vulnerability and communication.
sentences.zh: 它们再次是：信任、脆弱感和沟通。

sentences.en: And if you don't have those, you won't be able to be emotionally intimate with someone else.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有这些，你将无法与其他人建立情感上的亲密。

sentences.en: And I think that differs from physical intimacy a lot.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这与身体上的亲密有很大不同。

sentences.en: I don't even think that needs explaining,
sentences.zh: 我甚至觉得这不需要解释，

sentences.en: but sometimes we use physical intimacy to kind of mask our vulnerability and to kind of prevent us from having to be emotionally intimate with someone.
sentences.zh: 但有时我们用身体上的亲密来掩饰我们的脆弱感，并以此来阻止我们不得不与某人建立情感上的亲密。

sentences.en: Hence the idea of emotional unavailability.
sentences.zh: 因此便有了情感疏离的概念。

sentences.en: When we see a relationship only as chemistry and only as that spark, we forget about the thing that matters the most,
sentences.zh: 当我们把一段关系仅仅看作是化学反应和火花时，我们就忘记了最重要的事情，

sentences.en: which is that deep connection and ability to be present with someone and to let them in.
sentences.zh: 那就是那种深层的联系以及与某人共处并让他们走进内心的能力。

sentences.en: And I think that's where we see the idea of platonic soulmates really come into play, because in that situation, there isn't that sexual element.
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是柏拉图式灵魂伴侣的概念真正发挥作用的地方，因为在这种情况下，没有那种性元素。

sentences.en: There isn't that physical intimacy.
sentences.zh: 没有那种身体上的亲密。

sentences.en: The relationship is built on purely a foundation of emotional intimacy and then also mental and spiritual intimacy as well.
sentences.zh: 这种关系纯粹建立在情感亲密的基础之上，同时也建立在精神和心灵亲密的基础之上。

sentences.en: I kind of want to take a moment to talk about my own platonic soulmates.
sentences.zh: 我其实想花点时间谈谈我自己的柏拉图式灵魂伴侣。

sentences.en: For a while, I think I didn't really believe in this idea that you could have a soulmate that wasn't someone you were romantically attached to or attracted to.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，我想我并不是真的很相信这种观点，即你可以拥有一个并非浪漫依恋或吸引对象的灵魂伴侣。

sentences.en: We're so, like I said, this very narrow narrative that soulmates are the people that you marry.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，我们被这种非常狭隘的叙事所束缚，认为灵魂伴侣就是和你结婚的人。

sentences.en: They're the people that you build a family with.
sentences.zh: 他们是和你一起组建家庭的人。

sentences.en: They're the loves of your life.
sentences.zh: 他们是你生命中的挚爱。

sentences.en: And then suddenly I entered this era of my life, of my 20s, in which that entire spectrum, that entire era and field of romance, my romantic life basically kind of shut off.
sentences.zh: 然后突然间，我进入了我生命中的这个阶段，在我的二十多岁时，那个关于浪漫的全部光谱、整个领域和范畴，也就是我的浪漫生活基本上算是关闭了。

sentences.en: And when I allowed that area of my life to kind of fizzle and to take kind of be put on the back burner, essentially,
sentences.zh: 而当我允许我生活中的那个领域逐渐消淡并被暂时搁置时，本质上来说，

sentences.en: all of these relationships and all of these friendships started blossoming and blooming into friendships that I never could have imagined.
sentences.zh: 所有这些关系和所有这些友谊开始绽放并盛开成我从未想象过的友谊。

sentences.en: And I think about this one example of this amazing person, her name is Gracie,
sentences.zh: 我想到了一个关于这个了不起的人的例子，她叫格雷西，

sentences.en: that I met last year and almost instantly she entered my life and it was a feeling that I have never experienced.
sentences.zh: 我去年遇到了她，几乎是在瞬间她就走进了我的生活，那是一种我从未体验过的感觉。

sentences.en: I've never experienced it when it comes to dating.
sentences.zh: 当涉及到约会时，我从未体验过这种感觉。

sentences.en: I've never experienced it really in any domain.
sentences.zh: 在任何领域，我都真的从未体验过这种感觉。

sentences.en: It was like this instant recognition that in some way we were the same person and in some way I knew that she would be in my life forever.
sentences.zh: 就像是一种瞬间的认知，在某种程度上我们是同一个人，在某种程度上我知道她将永远留在我的生活中。

sentences.en: And it was so confronting.
sentences.zh: 而且这让人感到非常震撼。

sentences.en: But I remember like saying that to her and being like, I think we're going to be best friends.
sentences.zh: 但我记得当时对她说那样的话，就像是，我觉得我们要成为最好的朋友了。

sentences.en: I think that we are going to be amazing for each other.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们将成为彼此生命中最棒的人。

sentences.en: And when I said that, all I can think about was those examples of people who go on a date with someone and recount at their wedding,
sentences.zh: 当我这么说的时候，我脑子里想到的全都是那些与某人约会并在婚礼上重述的例子，

sentences.en: how they told them they were going to marry them.
sentences.zh: 讲述他们是如何告诉对方自己要娶他们的。

sentences.en: Like it really did kind of feel like that.
sentences.zh: 就像真的有点那种感觉。

sentences.en: It felt like, wow, have I just met like the love of my life?
sentences.zh: 感觉就像是，哇，我是不是刚刚遇到了我生命中的挚爱？

sentences.en: And in some ways I think that I had.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面我想我的确遇到了。

sentences.en: I think when I allowed my brain to see my relationships and the deep relationships I had with people as more than just romantic connections and I stopped pigeonholing all of my relationships into kind of like either these are romantic or they're just friendships.
sentences.zh: 我想，当我允许我的大脑把我和人们的关系以及深厚的情谊看作不仅仅是浪漫的连接，当我不再把我的所有关系狭隘地归类为要么是浪漫的要么仅仅是友谊时，

sentences.en: This whole new level of intimacy and vulnerability opened up for me.
sentences.zh: 一种全新的亲密感和脆弱感为我打开了。

sentences.en: And it was just the most amazing experience and has provided me with so much joy.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是最奇妙的体验，并带给我如此多的快乐。

sentences.en: And especially in our 20s when we really are reaching for connection, stumbling across a platonic soulmate just feels like it feels life changing.
sentences.zh: 特别是在我们二十多岁的时候，当我们真正渴望建立联系时，偶然遇到一个柏拉图式的灵魂伴侣，真的会让人觉得改变了人生。

sentences.en: So what I want to talk about next is what actually makes a platonic soulmate and how we can know and how we can identify if someone we've met might just be one of these people.
sentences.zh: 所以接下来我想谈的是，究竟是什么造就了一个柏拉图式的灵魂伴侣，我们如何去了解以及如何去识别我们遇到的人是否正是这样的人。

sentences.en: So all of that and more in just a second.
sentences.zh: 所有这些以及更多内容，马上就来。

sentences.en: I feel like I spent the first half of this episode really just going on a bit of a rant about how amazing platonic soulmates are and why romance and sex isn't everything.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这集的前半部分我都在大发感慨，讲柏拉图式的灵魂伴侣有多么了不起，以及为什么浪漫和性并不是全部。

sentences.en: And I guess you could you could probably hear that I'm very passionate about this, but I didn't really give us or you guys much information about what exactly that means.
sentences.zh: 我想你大概能听出我对这个话题充满热情，但我并没有真正向大家提供太多关于这到底意味着什么的具体信息。

sentences.en: What does it actually mean for someone to be a quote unquote platonic soulmate?
sentences.zh: 一个人被称为所谓的“柏拉图式灵魂伴侣”，到底意味着什么？

sentences.en: Firstly, I think the thing that distinguishes them from a romantic soulmate and our concept of a romantic soulmate is that you can have more than one.
sentences.zh: 首先，我认为将他们与浪漫的灵魂伴侣以及我们对浪漫灵魂伴侣的概念区分开来的地方在于，你可以拥有不止一个。

sentences.en: Like I said before,
sentences.zh: 就像我之前说的，

sentences.en: there is this very narrow lens that we were typically used to viewing soulmates through and that is that they are these romantic partners and we have one and we found them.
sentences.zh: 我们通常习惯通过一个非常狭隘的视角来看待灵魂伴侣，那就是他们是我们的浪漫伴侣，我们只有一个并且我们找到了他们。

sentences.en: But really, you can have more than one soulmate.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，你可以拥有不止一个灵魂伴侣。

sentences.en: A soulmate is someone that you choose to invest in and it's an individual who you feel a deep connection with.
sentences.zh: 灵魂伴侣是你选择投入其中的人，是一个让你感受到深层连接的个体。

sentences.en: And there are so many people on this planet.
sentences.zh: 这个星球上有这么多的人。

sentences.en: You are bound to feel that with more than one person.
sentences.zh: 你注定会和不止一个人产生这种感觉。

sentences.en: And I'm not saying that in a cynical way of, you know, the idea of soulmates doesn't even exiSt.
sentences.zh: 我这么说并不是出于那种愤世嫉俗的观点，你知道的，就好像灵魂伴侣根本不存在一样。

sentences.en: But I think that I don't like the idea of a soulmate singular.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我不喜欢单数形式的“灵魂伴侣”这个概念。

sentences.en: I like the idea of a soulmate plural.
sentences.zh: 我挺喜欢多个灵魂伴侣这个概念的。

sentences.en: And that's essentially why I think platonic soulmates are so,
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是为什么我认为柏拉图式灵魂伴侣如此、

sentences.en: so fascinating and so worthwhile to discuss because it really pushes back against this narrative that there is one person out there for you.
sentences.zh: 如此迷人且非常值得探讨，因为这确实是在反驳那种“世界上总有一个注定属于你的人”的说法。

sentences.en: They will fulfill you, they will make you the happiest version of yourself and everyone else is kind of secondary to that.
sentences.zh: 这个人会让你感到圆满，会让你成为自己最快乐的版本，而其他人相比之下都成了次要的。

sentences.en: I also think they define the typical idea and the typical structure of a friendship.
sentences.zh: 我也认为他们重新定义了友谊的典型概念和典型结构。

sentences.en: Typical friendships, as we know in psychology, are based off of three kind of conditions and they're formed in the presence of three conditions.
sentences.zh: 正如我们在心理学中所了解的那样，传统的友谊基于三种条件，并且是在这三种条件同时存在的情况下形成的。

sentences.en: And those are proximity, similarity and reciprocity.
sentences.zh: 这三个条件分别是：接近性、相似性和互惠性。

sentences.en: So, essentially, for a friendship to form, you need to be close to that person.
sentences.zh: 所以，从本质上讲，要建立一段友谊，你需要和这个人离得很近。

sentences.en: Distance can't really be a problem because you need to have the convenience and, well,
sentences.zh: 距离不能是个问题，因为你需要有那种便利性，而且，呃，

sentences.en: I guess just the convenience of being able to run into them and readily organize plans and actually see them in your daily life.
sentences.zh: 我想就是那种能够在日常生活中偶遇他们、轻松安排聚会并真正见到他们的便利。

sentences.en: The second is similarity.
sentences.zh: 第二个是相似性。

sentences.en: I think this comes down to values.
sentences.zh: 我认为这归结为价值观。

sentences.en: It is very hard, not impossible, but very hard, I would say, to cultivate a friendship with someone that you have nothing in common with.
sentences.zh: 要与一个和你毫无共同点的人培养友谊是非常困难的，虽说并非不可能，但我认为真的很难。

sentences.en: All friendships need this bedrock of similarity.
sentences.zh: 所有的友谊都需要这种相似性的基石。

sentences.en: And maybe that similarity in regards to the university that you both attend or some hobby or passion that you have or a similarity in terms of values.
sentences.zh: 也许这种相似性体现在你们俩都上的大学、你们拥有的一些爱好或激情，或者是在价值观上的相似。

sentences.en: It doesn't really matter, but typically a friendship cannot form if there isn't something kind of linking you together and some joint intereSt.
sentences.zh: 这其实并不重要，但通常情况下，如果没有某种东西把你们联系在一起以及某种共同的兴趣，友谊就无法形成。

sentences.en: And the final condition for a typical friendship is reciprocity.
sentences.zh: 传统友谊的最后一个条件是互惠性。

sentences.en: So, essentially, what that means is that you reciprocate each other's intentions and you reciprocate each other's energy.
sentences.zh: 所以，从本质上讲，这意味着你们回报彼此的意图，并且回报彼此的精力。

sentences.en: So, we do need those three conditions to be met to make any friendship.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们需要满足这三个条件才能建立任何友谊。

sentences.en: But as a friendship gains its deepness, as you might come to realize that this person you're friends with may be more than just a friend, they may be a platonic soulmate,
sentences.zh: 但随着友谊加深，当你可能意识到这个朋友可能不仅仅是朋友，他们可能是柏拉图式的灵魂伴侣时，

sentences.en: some of those conditions actually become less important.
sentences.zh: 其中一些条件实际上变得不那么重要了。

sentences.en: And we've got to remind ourselves, the idea of a platonic soulmate still rests on that assumption of this deep, soulful, fate-like bond.
sentences.zh: 我们要提醒自己，柏拉图式灵魂伴侣的概念仍然建立在那种深厚、饱含灵性、命中注定的纽带的假设之上。

sentences.en: And those bonds do not disappear with distance.
sentences.zh: 这些纽带不会因距离而消失。

sentences.en: They do not disappear with similarity.
sentences.zh: 它们不会因相似性的消失而消失。

sentences.en: And in some cases, they do not disappear, even if you guys are no longer in each other's lives and reciprocating the effort that is put in.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，它们也不会消失，哪怕你们不再处于彼此的生活中，也不再对付出的努力作出回应。

sentences.en: A soulmate is going to exist regardless of whether you guys are in constant contact or around each other 24-7,
sentences.zh: 无论你们是否保持经常联系或二十四小时朝夕相处，灵魂伴侣都将存在，

sentences.en: because it's almost like this dual energy source that you're both tapping into and you both share in some ways.
sentences.zh: 因为这几乎就像是你们两人都在汲取并以某种方式共同分享的双重能量源。

sentences.en: The idea is that this bond never fades because it was predestined.
sentences.zh: 这个理念是，这种纽带永远不会褪色，因为它是命中注定的。

sentences.en: And with platonic soulmates, I think there's a lot less pressure that's placed on them.
sentences.zh: 对于柏拉图式的灵魂伴侣，我认为放在他们身上的压力要小得多。

sentences.en: When we think about our romantic relationships and our romantic soulmates, there is a lot of rhetoric around the need to have children and the need to get married.
sentences.zh: 当我们想到浪漫关系和浪漫的灵魂伴侣时，有很多关于需要生孩子和需要结婚的言论。

sentences.en: And then we have these financial responsibilities that kind of fall into our lap when we become a couple.
sentences.zh: 当我们结为伴侣时，还有一些财务责任会落到我们头上。

sentences.en: And as we get older, we've got to share finances and make compromises.
sentences.zh: 随着年龄增长，我们需要分担财务并作出妥协。

sentences.en: And in platonic relationships and platonic soulmates, I think that's less of a priority.
sentences.zh: 而在柏拉图式的关系和柏拉图式的灵魂伴侣中，我认为这不那么重要。

sentences.en: You are more able to allow the other person to just be who they want to be without the pressure of being romantically intertwined.
sentences.zh: 你更能允许对方做自己，而没有纠缠于浪漫关系的压力。

sentences.en: And I think that's where we really see the distinction between a relationship and a romantic soulmate, a platonic soulmate, and then just a friendship.
sentences.zh: 我认为正是在这里，我们真正看到了普通关系与浪漫灵魂伴侣、柏拉图式灵魂伴侣以及普通友谊之间的区别。

sentences.en: There is not as much pressure to be in each other's pockets all the time and to have all those shared responsibilities,
sentences.zh: 双方没有那么多整天黏在一起以及承担所有这些共同责任的压力，

sentences.en: but it's also a friendship that is deeper and has a more lasting bond than a typical acquaintance or a typical friendship.
sentences.zh: 但这也是一段比典型泛泛之交或普通友谊更深厚、纽带更持久的友谊。

sentences.en: That intersection of those two ideas is where we find our platonic soulmate.
sentences.zh: 这两种观点的交汇点，就是我们找到柏拉图式灵魂伴侣的地方。

sentences.en: So how do you know if someone in your life is a platonic soulmate?
sentences.zh: 那么，你如何知道生命中的某个人是不是你的柏拉图式灵魂伴侣呢？

sentences.en: I think that's actually kind of a question and an answer in itself, because if you have to ask yourself that question, they're probably not.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这本身既是个问题也是个答案，因为如果你需要问自己这个问题，那他们大概就不是。

sentences.en: And I know that's really harsh, but the idea of a soulmate is that your soul and their soul recognize each other.
sentences.zh: 我知道这听起来很残酷，但灵魂伴侣的概念就是你的灵魂和他们的灵魂能够互相认出彼此。

sentences.en: And I know that's not based in a lot of psychology, and there is probably a very, very intricate biological, psychological explanation as to why we think that's the case.
sentences.zh: 我知道这并没有多少心理学依据，而且对于我们为什么会这么认为，可能存在非常非常复杂、微观的生物学和心理学解释。

sentences.en: But if we're just talking in terms of this kind of general archetype in this narrative, it is this idea that your soul recognizes another soul.
sentences.zh: 但如果我们仅仅从这种叙事中的一般原型来谈，这就是你的灵魂认出了另一个灵魂的概念。

sentences.en: So if you have to double back and really question that and you have to question whether they're your platonic soulmate, the chances are that they're not.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你需要回过头来反复斟酌，并且不得不去怀疑对方是否是你的柏拉图式灵魂伴侣，那多半说明他们不是。

sentences.en: But there are some other signs that are really strong and important to remember.
sentences.zh: 不过，还有其他一些非常强烈且值得记住的迹象。

sentences.en: So there is that instant recognition.
sentences.zh: 首先就是那种瞬间的认同感。

sentences.en: It's almost like family, almost like you've known them in a past life.
sentences.zh: 这几乎就像家人一样，就像你曾在前世认识他们一样。

sentences.en: And once again, that is not a psychological term.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这不是一个心理学术语。

sentences.en: In psychology, the idea of a past life is not one that is seen as valid or reliable, but you can believe in what you want to believe.
sentences.zh: 在心理学中，前世的概念并不被视为有效或可靠的，但你可以相信你愿意相信的东西。

sentences.en: And it's this idea that we have past selves, we've lived lives before.
sentences.zh: 那就是我们拥有过去的自我，我们曾经活过。

sentences.en: And in those lives, someone that you were close to or someone that was important to you has returned in the form or the body of a soulmate in this life.
sentences.zh: 在那些生命中，某个与你亲近或对你很重要的人，在今生以灵魂伴侣的形式或肉体回来了。

sentences.en: So that's kind of more of a spiritually enlightened idea of this recognition.
sentences.zh: 所以，这可以说是对这种认同感的一种更具精神觉悟的理解。

sentences.en: But I think that instant recognition that we feel can also be explained by some science as well.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得我们感受到的那种瞬间认同感，也可以用一些科学来解释。

sentences.en: Similarity is incredibly powerful.
sentences.zh: 相似性具有不可思议的强大力量。

sentences.en: If you share the same values as someone, if you share the same interests as someone, if you share the same neighborhood as someone and the same friends as them as well,
sentences.zh: 如果你和某人有相同的价值观，有相同的兴趣，住在同一个社区，还有着相同的朋友，

sentences.en: it makes it a lot easier for you to get along.
sentences.zh: 那你们就会更容易相处。

sentences.en: And so when you initially meet someone and you're doing all those, that kind of initial snooping work and seeing where they stand and seeing what they're all about,
sentences.zh: 因此，当你最初遇到某人，做那些初步的“侦查”工作，看看他们的立场是什么，了解他们到底是怎样的人时，

sentences.en: often in those instances, the part of our brain that is searching for similar connections is going to see their similarity to us as a real positive trait.
sentences.zh: 通常在这些情况下，我们大脑中寻找相似连接的那部分，会把他们与我们的相似之处视为一个非常积极的特征。

sentences.en: And therefore attach ourselves to them at a greater rate and kind of magnify how much we like them.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们会以更快的速度依恋他们，并放大我们对他们的喜爱程度。

sentences.en: So that's kind of more of a psychological explanation for that recognition.
sentences.zh: 所以，这可以说是对这种认同感的一种更偏向心理学的解释。

sentences.en: And the recognition is perhaps the biggest indicator of a platonic soulmate.
sentences.zh: 这种认同感也许是柏拉图式灵魂伴侣最重要的指标。

sentences.en: The next is one that I mentioned before, but you should be able to be your best self, but also your worst self with that person.
sentences.zh: 接下来是我之前提到过的一点，你应该能够在那个人面前展现最好的自己，也能展现最糟糕的自己。

sentences.en: I was having this discussion with a friend the other day, actually, and it's this person that I have known since I was like maybe 10 or 11 years old.
sentences.zh: 其实我前几天正和一位朋友讨论这件事，我认识她大概从我10岁或11岁左右开始。

sentences.en: She is my best friend.
sentences.zh: 她是我最好的朋友。

sentences.en: She is a platonic soulmate.
sentences.zh: 她是我的柏拉图式灵魂伴侣。

sentences.en: I don't even want to use the term platonic.
sentences.zh: 我甚至都不想用“柏拉图式”这个词。

sentences.en: She is just a soulmate.
sentences.zh: 她就是我的灵魂伴侣。

sentences.en: And I was saying to her,
sentences.zh: 我当时对她说，

sentences.en: isn't it just so beautiful that no matter what we do in life, you could do the worst thing a person could ever do and I could still love you.
sentences.zh: 无论我们在生活中做什么，这难道不是很美好吗？即使你做了人这辈子能做出的最糟糕的事，我也依然爱你。

sentences.en: I might not forgive you.
sentences.zh: 我可能不会原谅你。

sentences.en: I might not agree with what you've done, but I would still love you and I would still support you.
sentences.zh: 我可能不赞同你做过的事，但我依然会爱你，依然会支持你。

sentences.en: And that is just the most powerful feeling for someone to say to you, I think, the most powerful thing for someone to say to you, to say, regardless of your worst self,
sentences.zh: 我觉得，当有人对你说出这样的话时，这绝对是最有力量的感觉，当有人对你说：不管你有多糟糕，

sentences.en: I will still love you.
sentences.zh: 我依然爱你。

sentences.en: And I think it also comes with the idea that if you're saying that to someone, you probably know what their worst self is already and you're willing to accept that.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得这也意味着，如果你对某人说出这样的话，你大概已经知道他们最糟糕的一面是什么了，并且你愿意接受那一面。

sentences.en: So it's not like they're going to turn into like a mass murderer.
sentences.zh: 所以这倒不是说他们会变成什么连环杀人犯。

sentences.en: You probably wouldn't say that to someone who you're convinced is actually inherently a bad person.
sentences.zh: 你大概不会对一个你确信本质上是个坏人的人说这种话。

sentences.en: But regardless of that,
sentences.zh: 但不管怎样，

sentences.en: I do still think that is a really massive component of the deepness of this connection is your willingness to accept them when they are on their best behavior,
sentences.zh: 我依然觉得这种连接深度中非常关键的一个组成部分，就是你愿意接纳他们最好的一面，

sentences.en: when they are on their worst behavior, when they are the best version of themselves or the worst version of themselves.
sentences.zh: 最坏的一面，当他们处于最好的状态或最坏的状态时。

sentences.en: It's all a package deal, right?
sentences.zh: 这一切都是打包在一起的，对吧？

sentences.en: And you're willing to accept that.
sentences.zh: 而你愿意接受这一点。

sentences.en: But the next indicator, I think, is that it's easy.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得下一个指标是，这一切都很轻松。

sentences.en: The best relationships in life are easy.
sentences.zh: 生活中最好的关系都是轻松的。

sentences.en: They don't require you to push yourself to a point of being uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 它们不需要你逼自己到一个感到不舒服的程度。

sentences.en: They don't leave you questioning, oh, what are we going to talk about when we see each other next?
sentences.zh: 它们不会让你纠结：哦，下次见面我们要聊什么？

sentences.en: There is none of that friction.
sentences.zh: 完全没有那种摩擦感。

sentences.en: And I think that that friction is really noticeable in some relationships.
sentences.zh: 我觉得在某些关系中，这种摩擦感其实非常明显。

sentences.en: And in a platonic soulmate situation, it's probably there is none.
sentences.zh: 而在柏拉图式灵魂伴侣这种情况下，可能完全没有。

sentences.en: There shouldn't be any friction.
sentences.zh: 根本不应该有任何摩擦。

sentences.en: It should just feel like you're flowing down.
sentences.zh: 感觉应该就像顺流而下。

sentences.en: A very easygoing river and this person is by your side.
sentences.zh: 一条非常平缓的河流，而这个人就在你身边。

sentences.en: I think there is also this mutual understanding of the other person's needs.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这也包含对彼此需求的相互理解。

sentences.en: Obviously not without communication and you still need to communicate those.
sentences.zh: 当然，这离不开沟通，你仍然需要把这些需求表达出来。

sentences.en: But it's this awareness of what they need in their life.
sentences.zh: 但这是对他们在生活中所需之物的一种觉察。

sentences.en: If it's this awareness of, I guess, their love languages and their insecurities and maybe some of their childhood wounds,
sentences.zh: 如果这也是一种觉察，我猜，是对他们的爱的语言、不安全感，以及可能的一些童年创伤的觉察，

sentences.en: all of that is something that the other person has taken time to understand and still loves about you, but is also willing to address with you, with you by their side.
sentences.zh: 所有这一切，都是对方花时间去理解、并且依然爱你的一部分，同时也愿意与你一同面对，而你就在他们身边。

sentences.en: And then there are some other ones that I think are just added bonuses, right?
sentences.zh: 然后还有一些其他的，我觉得纯粹是锦上添花，对吧？

sentences.en: And are definitely indicators of this type of relationship.
sentences.zh: 而且绝对是这种关系的标志。

sentences.en: Laughter.
sentences.zh: 笑声。

sentences.en: Laughter is the most amazing thing.
sentences.zh: 笑声是最美妙的事情。

sentences.en: And I think it's because when we're enjoying someone's company and we feel free to laugh and to be entertained by them, we are saying to them,
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是因为，当我们享受某人的陪伴，并且能够毫无顾忌地欢笑、被他们逗乐时，我们是在向他们传达：

sentences.en: I am so totally comfortable with you and I'm not laughing because I'm nervous.
sentences.zh: 我和你在一起感到无比自在，我笑不是因为我紧张。

sentences.en: I'm not laughing because this is the natural response to you telling a bad joke.
sentences.zh: 我笑不是因为这是你讲了个烂笑话时的本能反应。

sentences.en: It's because I genuinely find you funny and because I genuinely love being around you.
sentences.zh: 是因为我真的觉得你很有趣，是因为我真的喜欢和你在一起。

sentences.en: And it's kind of like those situations.
sentences.zh: 这有点像那种情况。

sentences.en: I don't know if you've ever had those where you're with a friend and like me and my friends call it the sillies.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你有没有过这种经历，就是和朋友在一起——我和我的朋友们称之为“傻乐”。

sentences.en: Like everything they do is just hilarious because you feel so comfortable that all of that joy and happiness kind of bubbles to the surface.
sentences.zh: 就像他们做的每件事都极其搞笑，因为你感到如此自在，以至于所有的喜悦和快乐都涌上心头。

sentences.en: It's not that they're, you know, the next Jerry Seinfeld or the next Amy Poehler.
sentences.zh: 并不是因为他们是下一个杰瑞·宋飞或下一个艾米·波勒。

sentences.en: They don't have to be like the most hilarious person technically, but it's because they allow your joy to bubble over.
sentences.zh: 从技术层面上讲，他们不一定是最搞笑的人，而是因为他们能让你的快乐满溢出来。

sentences.en: And I think that is just the most beautiful thing.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这简直是最美好的事情。

sentences.en: They also allow you to sit in silence.
sentences.zh: 他们还允许你享受沉默。

sentences.en: You can sit in silence with this person and it not be awkward.
sentences.zh: 你可以和这个人相对无言，而不会觉得尴尬。

sentences.en: It all comes back to that sense of being comfortable in their presence because some part of you recognizes some part of them and you both know it's the same.
sentences.zh: 这一切都归结于在对方面前感到自在的那种感觉，因为你身上的某个部分认出了他们身上的某个部分，而且你们都知道这是一样的。

sentences.en: You recognize a part of yourself in that other person.
sentences.zh: 你在那个人身上看到了自己的影子。

sentences.en: And they help you grow.
sentences.zh: 他们还能助你成长。

sentences.en: They help you become a better version of yourself because they know you well enough to know what's going to motivate you.
sentences.zh: 他们帮你成为更好的自己，因为他们足够了解你，知道什么能激励你。

sentences.en: They know you well enough to know what are you insecure about, but what are also your ambitions?
sentences.zh: 他们足够了解你，知道你的不安全感是什么，但同时也知道你的雄心壮志是什么。

sentences.en: And I am so invested in your life.
sentences.zh: 我全心投入你的生活。

sentences.en: You are so invested in mine that I want to be able to bring you to that level where you want to be.
sentences.zh: 你也全心投入我的生活，以至于我想把你带到你想去的高度。

sentences.en: So I guess that's kind of an extensive liSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我想这是一个相当长的清单。

sentences.en: But when I was thinking back to my own experiences with this idea of a platonic soulmate, those were the things that really came to mind for me.
sentences.zh: 但当我回想自己关于柏拉图式灵魂伴侣这个概念的经历时，这些确实是我脑海中最先浮现的东西。

sentences.en: And they were the ones that really stood out to me as distinguishing perhaps just a regular friendship or a regular acquaintance and this kind of deeper,
sentences.zh: 正是这些特质让我真正注意到，它们或许能区分普通的朋友或点头之交，与这种更深层次的、

sentences.en: inexplicable connection that we just appear to have with some people.
sentences.zh: 无法解释的连接——我们似乎与某些人自然而然地拥有的这种连接。

sentences.en: I do want to say here, though, there is a lot of hype around this idea of soulmates, platonic, romantic or otherwise.
sentences.zh: 不过，我在这里想说的是，关于灵魂伴侣这个概念——无论是柏拉图式的、浪漫的还是其他类型的——存在着很多炒作。

sentences.en: And sometimes that can leave those of us who don't quite know if we've met these people feeling like a failure, feeling like there's something wrong with us,
sentences.zh: 有时这会让我们这些不太确定自己是否遇到过这样的人感到自己很失败，觉得我们身上出了什么问题，

sentences.en: that everyone around us is having these deep, meaningful connections and we're not.
sentences.zh: 觉得周围每个人都有这种深刻、有意义的连接，而我们却没有。

sentences.en: I don't think that's the case.
sentences.zh: 我不认为情况是这样的。

sentences.en: I really don't think that's the case.
sentences.zh: 我真的不认为情况是这样的。

sentences.en: I think I am a big proponent of the argument that soulmates are not just met, they're also made.
sentences.zh: 我非常支持这种观点：灵魂伴侣不仅是遇见的，也是培养出来的。

sentences.en: There may be someone in your life who, with the bit of extra effort and energy and the time to build that vulnerability, will be a platonic soulmate, will be your person.
sentences.zh: 你生命中可能正有这样一个人，只要付出一点额外的努力、精力和时间去建立这种脆弱感，就会成为你的柏拉图式灵魂伴侣，成为那个对的人。

sentences.en: But I also like to remind myself at times, and I like to remind others who feel insecure about the fact that maybe their relationships aren't as deep as they would like them to be,
sentences.zh: 但我也喜欢时常提醒自己，我也想提醒其他人——他们可能会因为自己的关系没有达到自己希望的那么深厚而感到不安——

sentences.en: that you haven't yet met all the people that you have loved and all the people who will love you.
sentences.zh: 你还没遇到所有你爱过的人，也没遇到所有会爱上你的人。

sentences.en: Your future is so wide, especially for those of us in our 20s, and you have decades ahead of you to meet the most spectacular, amazing people, and you should wait for them.
sentences.zh: 你的未来无比广阔，特别是对我们这些二十多岁的人来说，你们还有几十年的时间去遇到最壮丽、最棒的人，你们应该等待他们。

sentences.en: You shouldn't force it with someone.
sentences.zh: 你不应该勉强和某人在一起。

sentences.en: I promise that these people show up when you least expect them, and I hate that saying, but I guess it's true, which annoys me even more.
sentences.zh: 我向你保证，这些人会在你最意想不到的时候出现，我讨厌这种说法，但我想这是真的，这让我更加恼火。

sentences.en: But they will just show up in your life when you most need them and when you least expect them.
sentences.zh: 但他们就会在你最需要他们、最意想不到的时候闯入你的生活。

sentences.en: And like I said, there will be that instant recognition.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，会有那种瞬间的认出。

sentences.en: No one goes through life unloved, I think.
sentences.zh: 我觉得没有人的一生是无人爱护的。

sentences.en: There's not a single person I know in this world, not a single person who exists who I think goes through life unloved by at least someone around them or even a stranger.
sentences.zh: 在这个世界上，我认识的每一个人，存在的每一个人，我觉得没有一个不是被周围的某个人甚至是一个陌生人爱着的。

sentences.en: So you don't need to have met your platonic soulmate and have a best friend or the person that is the love of your life right now.
sentences.zh: 所以你不需要现在就遇到你的柏拉图式灵魂伴侣，并立刻拥有一个最好的朋友或此生挚爱。

sentences.en: That will come.
sentences.zh: 那会来的。

sentences.en: It will come.
sentences.zh: 它会来的。

sentences.en: And you can also cultivate that.
sentences.zh: 而且你也可以去培养它。

sentences.en: And you can be your own soulmate.
sentences.zh: 你也可以成为自己的灵魂伴侣。

sentences.en: Sometimes that's a really beautiful way of seeing things, that anything that you think a friendship or a relationship needs to give you, you can give yourself.
sentences.zh: 有时这是一种非常美好的看待事物的方式：你认为友谊或关系需要给予你的一切，你都可以自己给自己。

sentences.en: And that includes some of that unconditional love we were speaking about, some of that mutual understanding of needs, some of that laughter, some of that space to grow.
sentences.zh: 这包括我们刚才谈到的一些无条件地爱，一些对需求的相互理解，一些欢笑，一些成长的空间。

sentences.en: Those are all things that you can give to you.
sentences.zh: 这些都是你可以给予自己的东西。

sentences.en: And we don't always need to be looking outwardly to have those needs net.
sentences.zh: 我们并不总是需要向外寻求来满足这些需求。

sentences.en: So I just want to say that if you're listening to this being like, oh, my goodness, what am I doing wrong?
sentences.zh: 所以我想说的是，如果你在听这个节目时觉得，哦，天哪，我到底哪里做错了？

sentences.en: This platonic soulmate idea sounds amazing.
sentences.zh: 这个柏拉图式灵魂伴侣的概念听起来太棒了。

sentences.en: I want to get in on that.
sentences.zh: 我也想拥有。

sentences.en: And I haven't been able to yet.
sentences.zh: 但我到现在还没能拥有。

sentences.en: Don't worry about it.
sentences.zh: 别担心。

sentences.en: There'll be someone out there.
sentences.zh: 总会有人出现的。

sentences.en: There'll be multiple people out there who are going to show up in your life and fill that cup so full you're going to need more cups.
sentences.zh: 会有好几个人出现在你的生活中，把你的杯子填得那么满，以至于你需要更多的杯子。

sentences.en: So thank you so much for listening to today's episode.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家收听今天的单集。

sentences.en: If you have a platonic soulmate of your own, you should tell me about them or you should share this episode with them.
sentences.zh: 如果你有自己的柏拉图式灵魂伴侣，你应该告诉我，或者把这一期分享给他们。

sentences.en: Let them know that they are seen and that you love them and that you will always be there for them.
sentences.zh: 让他们知道他们被看见了，你爱他们，你将永远陪伴他们。

sentences.en: I'm going to send this episode to my platonic soulmate.
sentences.zh: 我要把这一期发给我的柏拉图式灵魂伴侣。

sentences.en: I'm hoping that she's already listening.
sentences.zh: 我希望她已经在听了。

sentences.en: But if not, here's her reminder to subscribe to my show and leave me a five star review.
sentences.zh: 如果还没听，这就是提醒她订阅我的节目并给我一个五星好评。

sentences.en: I'm hoping she's already done that as well.
sentences.zh: 我希望她也已经这么做了。

sentences.en: But if you haven't, you should take some time to leave a five star review wherever you are listening right now.
sentences.zh: 但如果你还没这样做，你应该花点时间在你现在收听的平台上留下一个五星好评。

sentences.en: It really helps the show to grow and to reach new people and new audiences.
sentences.zh: 这真的能帮助节目成长，触及更多人和新的听众。

sentences.en: And it also makes my day.
sentences.zh: 这也让我一整天都心情大好。

sentences.en: I read every single one of your reviews when I'm feeling good, when I'm feeling bad.
sentences.zh: 当我感觉好的时候，当我感觉糟糕的时候，我都会阅读你们的每一条评论。

sentences.en: They always just make me happier.
sentences.zh: 它们总能让我更高兴。

sentences.en: So if you have an episode suggestion as well, please feel free to follow me at That Psychology Podcast and send me a DM with your idea.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你也有节目选题的建议，请随时在 That Psychology Podcast 关注我，并通过私信把你的想法发给我。

sentences.en: I love hearing about your experiences and how they relate to my own, but also how they may be somewhat universal for a lot of us in our 20s.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢听你们的经历以及它们如何与我产生共鸣，同时也喜欢看它们对我们许多二十多岁的人来说是如何具有某种普遍性的。

sentences.en: So follow me over there and send me your episode suggestions, send me your feedback or just say hi.
sentences.zh: 所以去那里关注我，发给我你们的选题建议、反馈，或者只是打个招呼。

sentences.en: And as always, thank you so much for listening to today's episode.
sentences.zh: 一如既往，非常感谢大家收听今天的单集。

sentences.en: We will be back next week with another episode.
sentences.zh: 我们下周将带着另一期节目回归。

sentences.en: I've been approaching my health really differently this year.
sentences.zh: 我今年对待健康的方式真的很不一样。

sentences.en: I used to be really focused on maximizing and doing more.
sentences.zh: 我过去真的很专注于追求极限和做更多的事。

sentences.en: And now I'm just realizing that if I listen to what my body needs, I perform way better.
sentences.zh: 现在我才意识到，如果我倾听身体的需求，我的表现反而会好得多。

sentences.en: And that's why I am obsessed with my Whoop.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我痴迷于我的 Whoop。

sentences.en: Truly, you guys, you know, I'm such a data and information driven person.
sentences.zh: 真的，伙计们，你们知道的，我是个极度依赖数据和信息的人。

sentences.en: And I love opening my Whoop app and seeing how my sleep, my stress, my strain is correlating with my mood, with my running performance, with how I'm just feeling day to day.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢打开 Whoop 应用，看我的睡眠、压力、身体负荷是如何与我的心情、跑步表现以及我的日常生活感受相关联的。

sentences.en: I'm not an elite athlete by any means, but I do really benefit and I also just really enjoy knowing more about my body.
sentences.zh: 我绝不是什么顶尖运动员，但我确实从中获益匪浅，而且我也真的很喜欢更多地了解自己的身体。

sentences.en: And Whoop also gives me these actionable,
sentences.zh: Whoop 还为我提供这些切实可行的、

sentences.zh: 个性化的洞察，让我变得更有意识，这意味着我在日常生活中能根据自己的需求做出更明智的决定，而不是只顾着踩下油门，一直

sentences.zh: 一张电影票、一张登机牌，或者可能是某种只有对你才有意义的东西。
